notes:
A 400 from someone else's server is no longer called a dead link.

Docket audited its own site and reported two outbound links broken, advising
"update or remove each dead link". Both were Meta's own documentation for the
tracking pixel the linking page exists to describe — and both answered 400
because Meta declines automated requests, not because the pages are gone.

Those links now appear as "could not be checked", which is what Docket actually
knows. It will not pretend to be a browser to find out.

Proving that exposed an older gap: a page on your own site answering 400 was
reported by nothing at all. It is now reported, with advice to return 404 or 410
if the URL should not exist.
